about: What a clean build from inputs/ must produce, byte for byte (docs/plan/12, Reproducible build). The base table is round 7's strict.bin; round8Combined is round 8's strict-common.bin, which the build test rebuilds from today's table. Round 13's inline-typos.bin (731f6d7c…aaf27a) gained the authored typos that sit only at SCOWL level 95 or in web2. A data change updates these with the gate report in the same PR.
